summary: Kerb where cars park, backing onto dense bush, homes only across the road.

drivers.seclusion: Bush and a lone house set well back on the east side; houses with pools face it across the road, 17 m or more away.
drivers.access_and_room: Sealed street with four or five cars parked along the kerb in the Esri image; room to stop is shown.
drivers.traffic: Quiet end of a residential street, reaching a cross street to the south.
drivers.convention: Cars park along it; signs give 2P Mon-Fri 9am-5pm only, with no overnight restriction.

flags: Slight slope: about 3.7% at the best section, steeper to the south (18% max)
Homes across the road, 17 m or more away
Signs: 2P limit applies in weekday daytime hours
sun_shade: Heavy tree canopy on the east side shades it from the morning and midday sun.
cannot_judge: Whether the building at 9 m is a home

best_section.where: east kerb in the dead-end stretch below the bend, where cars park
